baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ... وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ ... يُرِيدُونَ/تُرِيدُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is made the object of restraint and located with a community; the doubled act of willing sets their aim against the addressee's possible aim, while the eyes perform the crossing between them.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from agitation supplies the active tether rather than passive waiting.
The self as the thing's very identity makes the whole person, not only a mood, remain with the group.
Willing or choosing is repeated at both indices and supplies the verse's rival directional aims.
Crossing beyond or away supplies the boundary violation enacted by the gaze.
The literal seeing organ becomes the mobile selector through which desire leaves one company for another.

changed_reading.before: Be patient with devout people and do not stare at worldly wealth.
changed_reading.after: Hold the whole self inside a chosen fellowship because attention is socially mobile: the eyes can carry the self across from one governing desire to another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling brackets the visible day at morning and evening, while seeking a face or direction gives that repetition a stable vector; companionship places the addressee inside this temporal orientation practice.

activation_trace.role: Vocal calling and drawing by speech supply the repeated communal act.
Nurture, repair, and completion make the called Lord the sustaining center of the routine.
Departure at the first of day supplies one temporal boundary.
Evening time supplies the other temporal boundary, making the practice recurrent rather than episodic.
Face as direction supplies the vector that joins the two daily endpoints.

changed_reading.before: They pray twice daily and seek God sincerely.
changed_reading.after: Their calling is a day-spanning orientation scaffold; remaining with them places the self inside a rhythm that repeatedly resets its direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The object rejected is not life or beauty without qualification but ornament attached to the near or lower life; the eye's crossing turns proximity and display into a ranking rule.

activation_trace.role: Direct visual observation supplies the channel by which displayed value becomes a criterion.
Visible ornament supplies the attractive surface being sought.
Life as benefit or good keeps the warning tied to an apparent good rather than to inert decoration alone.
Nearness supplies the immediacy bias in the worldly display.
Lowness supplies the evaluative degradation that proximity can conceal.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects beauty and worldly life as such.
changed_reading.after: The verse resists proximity bias: immediately visible ornament must not become the rule by which less displayed people are passed over.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The syntax presents a governable sequence: obedience gives authority to a heart displaced from recollection; that heart tracks inclination; its affair then exceeds its measure and is also forfeited through neglect.

activation_trace.role: Compliance supplies the transfer of practical authority to the heedless person.
Causing another to be inattentive marks heedlessness as an effected condition, not a stray lapse.
The heart supplies the inner orientation point from which the later actions proceed.
Recollection after or against forgetting supplies the absent stabilizing feedback.
Following in another's track supplies the transition from inner inclination to sustained conduct.
The liability that follows an act supplies the accumulating consequence of that conduct.
The self's desirous inclination supplies the moving guide once recollection is absent.
Exceeding limit or measure supplies the runaway side of the terminal condition.
Neglect, waste, and letting something lapse supply the terminal condition's forfeiture side.

changed_reading.before: Do not obey a bad person described by three unrelated faults.
changed_reading.after: Do not enter a feedback chain in which displaced recollection licenses inclination, following accumulates liability, and the affair becomes at once overrun and wasted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding command to recite or follow an unreplaceable book and seek no side refuge makes the focus command an embodied analogue: remain with the callers rather than substituting a more attractive social refuge.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the textual continuity that immediately precedes the social command.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the prohibited substitution pattern.
Leaning toward a refuge supplies the alternative shelter that the preceding verse closes off.
Guaranteeing and staying with someone turns restraint into durable personal attachment.
Crossing away supplies the focus verse's bodily form of attempted substitution.

structural_cues: 18:27 and 18:28 are adjacent imperatives, and both close routes of replacement or departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, non-substitution, no refuge, and then commanded companionship; I infer that textual fidelity is enacted as social non-substitution; alternatively, 18:27 may establish authority without specifying the social analogy.

changed_reading.before: The companionship command is a local interpersonal ethic.
changed_reading.after: Staying with the callers is also an embodied refusal to exchange the revealed orientation for a socially preferable refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sought Face in the focus verse is followed by human faces enclosed and roasted; the recurrence turns direction into exposure, so what one faces toward is linked to where one's own face becomes vulnerable.

activation_trace.role: Face as direction supplies the seekers' governing orientation.
An enclosure of overpowering destruction supplies the consequence-space around the human faces.
Cooking by heat supplies the bodily exposure suffered in that enclosure.
The literal human face supplies the vulnerable counterpart to the directional Face sought in the focus verse.

structural_cues: The same و ج ه root recurs in adjacent verses with divine and human referents, while 18:29 encloses the latter in fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent Face/faces and the enclosing heat; I infer an orientation-to-exposure relation, not identity between the referents; alternatively, the recurrence may be rhetorical contrast without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Seeking His Face is an abstract statement of sincere intention.
changed_reading.after: Seeking a face is an orientation with embodied stakes: the chosen direction governs the field in which one's own face is finally exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action is not lost but compensated, and the next scene joins jewelry, garments, and returning reward; this revises the focus warning from anti-ornament to a distinction between proximate display and adornment returned as the consequence of action.

activation_trace.role: Adornment worn or displayed supplies the focus verse's immediate attraction.
Nearness marks that attraction as immediate rather than final.
Loss or disappearance, here negated, supplies preservation across delay.
Compensation for work supplies the consequence-bearing economy of value.
Jewelry and adornment show that ornament itself remains available in the positive scene.
Garment and covering supply the scene's visible adornment under the same occurrence record as reward.
A worker's returning recompense supplies the delayed return encoded beside the garments.

structural_cues: 18:30-31 directly follow the warning, and 18:31 records ثيابا and ثواب under one root occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-loss, earned compensation, jewelry, garments, and reward; I infer that source and temporal return distinguish the adornments; alternatively, the passage may contrast two realms without making adornment consequential in this precise way.

changed_reading.before: Visible ornament is intrinsically opposed to devotion.
changed_reading.after: Immediate ornament is rejected as a social valuation rule, while adornment that returns from good action is affirmed; the issue is the value circuit, not beauty alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owner boasts of being more in wealth and stronger in following, while the companion later names being seen as less in wealth and child; these explicit comparatives reveal the forbidden eye movement as a social ranking operation.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by the eye supplies the focus verse's comparison channel.
Making value visibly attractive supplies the display on which ranking feeds.
Rivalrous superiority by number supplies the boast's comparative operator.
Accumulated wealth supplies one metric of superiority.
Strength and status supply the value assigned to the larger following.
A mobilizable supporting group supplies the human metric paired with wealth.
Seeing by eye or insight explicitly introduces the later comparison.
Smallness supplies the lower rank assigned through that seeing.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from أكثر منك in 18:34 to ترن أنا أقل منك in 18:39, echoing the focus verse's eyes and its social pronouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit visual and quantitative comparisons; I infer that the prohibited gaze is the comparator that converts display into human rank; alternatively, the primary fault may begin only when comparison becomes boast.

changed_reading.before: Do not look away from the poor toward richer people.
changed_reading.after: Disable the gaze as a ranking instrument: once display becomes a metric, people become more or less valuable by wealth and mobilizable following.

context_deltas.mechanism: The open formula of willing in 18:29 eventually meets the garden owner's inability to seek inaccessible water in 18:41; the shared ط و ع root moves from obeying in the focus verse to being able, suggesting that surrendering agency to inclination can end by shrinking agency itself.

activation_trace.role: Obedient compliance supplies the initial voluntary yielding of agency.
The self's inclination supplies the guide to which agency is yielded.
Will directed toward an object supplies the context's explicit field of choice.
Capacity and ability, here negated, supply the later foreclosure of action under the same root as obedience.
Searching for the lost water supplies the action that has become impossible.

structural_cues: The window places لَا تُطِعْ before فَمَن شَاءَ and later فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedience, willing, and later inability after material loss; I infer a yielding-to-foreclosure trajectory; alternatively, the physical disappearance of water alone may explain the inability without any habituation claim.

changed_reading.before: Do not comply with a morally unreliable leader.
changed_reading.after: Guard the capacity to act before it is ceded to inclination: apparent freedom to choose can consolidate into a condition in which the needed object can no longer even be reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory holds both excess and waste inside فُرُطًا; the garden sequence supplies a trajectory from multiplied wealth through expenditure to structural emptiness and collapse, allowing the two branches to describe one boom-to-forfeiture process.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding measure supplies the expansive phase of the affair.
Neglect, waste, and loss supply the same affair's terminal phase.
Growth in number supplies the visible surplus from which the boast begins.
Accumulated property supplies the stock being amplified.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the conversion of stock into sunk cost.
Falling and structural collapse supply the final forfeiture.

structural_cues: One owner's garden is followed from the comparative boast in 18:34 to expenditure and collapse in 18:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two ف ر ط branches and the surplus-spending-collapse sequence; I infer a causal boom-to-waste loop; alternatively, excess and neglect may be separate live senses rather than phases of one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: His affair is merely disorderly, excessive, or neglected.
changed_reading.after: His affair is furut as a boom-bust circuit: measureless accumulation generates commitments that end as waste and forfeiture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner first treats a larger supporting group as status, then has no faction able to help, and finally true protecting affiliation and the best outcome are assigned to God; the focus command to stay with callers therefore chooses a durable alliance rather than merely tolerating low-status company.

activation_trace.role: Guaranteeing, accompanying, and staying with others supply durable mutual attachment.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the fellowship's common allegiance.
A group mobilized for support supplies the owner's prestige network.
A faction returning to its head supplies the support body now absent.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the function that no faction can perform.
Protective love, aid, and alliance supply the durable affiliation reassigned to God.
The final outcome supplies the horizon on which competing affiliations are evaluated.

structural_cues: The narrative moves from أعز نفرا in 18:34 to no helping فئة in 18:43 and الولاية لله in 18:44, while the focus verse locates the self مع the callers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a boasted support group, failed factional aid, and divine affiliation; I infer that مع in the focus verse selects an alliance by durability; alternatively, it may require devotional presence without a broader alliance model.

changed_reading.before: Remain kindly in the company of socially unimpressive worshippers.
changed_reading.after: Choose the fellowship whose common allegiance survives status collapse; quantified followers are not the same as durable protecting affiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries vessel-edge and cultivated-boundary images into an ethical command. It remains anchored in the focus verse's restraint and prohibition on crossing beyond people, and in literal context enclosures. Render it as a spatial analogy about attention, not as a claim that the worshippers are literally a wall or garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱصْبِرْ ... مَعَ ... وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ

activation_trace.role: The sides or upper edge of a thing supply an exploratory boundary for restrained attention.
Crossing and passing beyond supply the attempted exit from that boundary.
Literal surrounding supplies one context model of an enclosing environment.
The surrounding pavilion supplies a destructive enclosure selected by wrong orientation.
A perimeter around a center supplies the cultivated enclosure of the two gardens.
A connection maintained between edges supplies the organized interior of that enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Freedom means escaping social constraint, so the verse merely restricts where one looks.
changed_reading.after: Attention is always environmentally enclosed; the command asks the self to choose the formative enclosure of remembrance rather than cross into an enclosure built by display and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links an inner heart in 18:28 to externally turning palms in 18:42 through one root image. It remains valid as a traced reversal pattern anchored in ق ل ب at both occurrences. Render it as narrative somatization of regret, not as proof that the focus occurrence lexically means hand-turning.

activation_trace.role: The heart supplies the hidden center whose orientation has been displaced from recollection.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the latent reversal image within that heart.
Repeated outward turning supplies the visible bodily reversal after the garden's loss.
The literal palms supply the body surface on which the inner reversal becomes legible.
Collapse supplies the event that externalizes the previously hidden misorientation.

changed_reading.before: A heedless heart is an invisible mental defect, and turning the palms is a separate gesture of regret.
changed_reading.after: The narrative externalizes the heart's prior turning-away: after collapse, the same reversal pattern reaches the palms and becomes publicly visible regret.

strongest_changes: The prohibited gaze became a social comparator that converts visible wealth and following into human rank.
Worldly adornment was distinguished from adornment returned as preserved compensation; beauty itself was not the rejected mechanism.
Obedience and ability formed a trajectory in which agency yielded to inclination can end as lost capacity.
Companionship became selection of a durable affiliation rather than condescension toward a low-status group.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated roots across the window did unusually precise work: و ج ه moved from sought direction to exposed faces, ط و ع from obedience to ability, ق ل ب from hidden heart to turning palms, and ث و ب joined clothing to returning reward. The garden sequence then materialized the focus verse's otherwise compressed gaze, status, excess, and loss mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The excess and neglect branches of ف ر ط may be phases of one boom-bust process or two coexisting senses.
The adjacent divine Face and human faces clearly contrast, but the orientation-to-exposure arrow remains reader-supplied.
The enclosure model is branch-backed and spatially coherent but should remain an analogy rather than a lexical claim.
